_comment: Central model config for the v2.1 pipeline. Change any value here to update the whole pipeline — no code edits needed.

paper_persona_v2_pipeline._note: Three distinct LLM families (Qwen / Gemma / DeepSeek) across stages for cross-family diversity — reduces self-preference in LLM-as-judge evaluation. Embeddings run locally via sentence-transformers (deterministic, no network dependency). All LLM calls use think=false + format=json.

cq_dedup_pipeline._note: Step 1 — intra-paper deduplication. think=True so chain-of-thought merge reasoning is captured in the output. One LLM call per paper (~20-35 CQs per call).

cq_generalize_pipeline._note: Step 2 — cross-paper generalisation. think=True for careful cross-paper semantic grouping and domain-level abstraction. One LLM call per archetype (10 calls total).

cq_validate_pipeline._note: Step 3 — RAG-based answer validation. think=False for speed — up to 80+ LLM calls (one per original CQ). Reuses FAISS indexes from v2/index/. Embed model must match the one used to build those indexes.

cq_consolidation_pipeline._note: Step 4 — cross-archetype consolidation + ontology schema extraction. N+1 LLM calls (one per archetype for Stage A, one for Stage B). Schema-constrained decoding via Pydantic v2.
